text_block_list.text:
Although it's time for her training<n>session, Biwa
Hayahide hasn't<n>shown up, so I decide to search
for<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... I'm so glad you asked.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There’s a salon that's holding a<n>special promotion
to help tame<n>"extremely voluminous hair," so I tried
it out!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I had five millimeters taken off, and<n>it's really
helped reduce wind<n>resistance! I'm sure today's
training<n>will be—
choice_data_list: Um, it's a bit late for that.
Um, it's a bit late for that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness! When did it get so<n>late?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I was so focused on<n>short-term
improvement that I lost<n>sight of my responsibilities!

She seems genuinely sorry, so I tell<n>her to take the
day off and come back<n>tomorrow for training.
